Header: Ustilago nuda f.sp. tritici Amharic: aramamo; Tigrigna: hatela ekili

Prevention: Use certified seed from a reliable source to ensure they are disease-free
If own seed is used, collect from healthy, disease-free fields.
Do not harvest infected wheat heads for seed purposes because the disease will appear again after planting
Carry out hot water treatment of seeds:
Soak seeds in cold water for 4 hours to reduce cracking and damaging of the seed and immerse in hot water at 54-55oC temperature for 10 mins
Use crop rotation with legume (lentil, bean, faba bean, chickpea) crops at least for 2 consecutive years
Monitoring: Monitor the crop weekly just after plants have started heading as the disease shows no symptoms until the plant starts to reach maturity
Look for sooty or charcoal-like powder, dark brown/black where the wheat grains should be.
These are spores produced by the fungus instead of the grains
When any diseased (smutted) heads are seen carry out the direct control measures
Direct Control: Remove the smutted heads showing symptoms of the disease
Do not dispose of infected heads in the field, take them outside the field and bury or burn
Do not use infected or diseased plant material for composting
Restrictions: There are currently no registered fungicides in
Ethiopia for management of this disease
